finding.title: Sign-in is not defined
finding.wrong_outcome: an implementer who follows the stated text as written builds a password sign-in for the re-authentication step (`the user must sign in again before any further request is accepted`, S:11), and that is wrong because the sign-in method may be single sign-on.

e1.text: the user must sign in again before any further request is accepted
e1.context:
## 2. Sessions
R5. A session expires after 30 minutes without activity.
R6. After expiry the user must sign in again before any further request is accepted.
R7. Admin sessions expire after 15 minutes without activity.
